entries.title: Refuted P0297 route: d_gamma = 2Q/xi
entries.statement: The intake attempt D0049-A001 wrote d_gamma=2Q/xi for Q=2/gamma+gamma/2. This is false at gamma=sqrt(8/3): the known d_gamma=4 gives xi=gamma/d_gamma=1/sqrt(6) and Q=5/sqrt(6), so 2Q/xi=10. The correct parameter identity xi=gamma/d_gamma does not itself evaluate d_gamma. Do not use the refuted equation to infer an LQG dimension.

relations.rationale: The corrected intake attempt concerns the same exact dimension target and prevents reuse of a numerically false parameter relation. Both statements are quoted in w527/EDGE_EVIDENCE.jsonl.
